summary: Iter65 — P0 handoff-readiness regression pass after the llm_provider.py seam + env-driven DNS_CNAME_TARGET + STORAGE_DRIVER=gridfs fallback. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iter65_llm_refactor.py (1 skipped — the direct llm_provider unit send_message test skipped in xdist worker because EMERGENT_LLM_KEY isn't propagated into the pytest subprocess env; the same seam is exercised indirectly by every AI endpoint test which all pass). Verified: llm_provider.llm_mode/llm_available/image_available/video_available/status shape; POST /apps/{id}/ai/edit round trips through get_chat().send_message and returns updated block JSON; POST /apps/{id}/ai/seo streams via chat.stream_message and returns 200; POST /apps/{id}/ai/lead-summary returns {counts.leads} 200; GET /media/config returns {elevenlabs,images:true,video:true,image_model,video_model} — booleans now computed by llm_provider.image_available()/video_available() as spec'd; POST /apps/{id}/media/image returns doc with data_url starting 'data:image/'; GET /ai/models returns catalogue+features+platform+image_model; PATCH /ai/models admin=200, editor=403 (auth still enforced); POST /apps/{id}/files upload, GET list (files+usage shape), GET /{fid}/download 200, GET /public/files/{path} returns 403 for private (default) — proxy storage driver unchanged; POST /apps/{id}/media/upload returns /api/public/files url; POST /apps/{id}/domain + POST /domain/verify returns domain_status in {pending,partial,verified} and domain_dns.cname.expected non-empty (env-driven DNS_CNAME_TARGET wired). Frontend smoke on live preview URL (admin login via email/password form, NOT google-oauth): /dashboard renders 2 tenant cards (TEST_iter64_toggle + Formcheck Medical), template gallery /templates renders '32 designs' header with 48 unique template-* data-testids (32 cards + 16 studio badges), clicking Formcheck opens /apps/app_d8a1146c7426 with OVERVIEW tab live (SITE MODE/CMS/APP MODE/WORKFLOWS/INBOX/FORMS/BOOKINGS/AI MEDIA/VIDEOS/FILES/DATA & STORAGE/BILLING/DOMAIN/HANDOFF & EXPORT/ACTIVITY/MEMBERS all present) and site analytics + hosting metrics render — ZERO pageerrors, ZERO console errors across the whole flow. No regression from the LLM refactor observed anywhere.
critical_code_review_comments: llm_provider.py is a clean single seam. get_chat() branches on llm_mode() and wraps both emergent (LlmChat via emergentintegrations) and byo (litellm) behind the same async send_message/stream_message contract that call sites already used — no call-site behavioural drift observed.

image_available() / video_available() correctly gate /media/config, /media/image and /media/video. The two BYO branches of generate_image and generate_speech raise a helpful RuntimeError instead of silently no-oping when the required key is missing — good.

extras.py: DNS_CNAME_TARGET is now `os.environ.get("DNS_CNAME_TARGET", "tenants.luciostudio.app")`. Fallback is a Lois-Tech domain — the handoff docs should call out that a self-hosting client MUST override this in .env or the DNS instructions returned to their end-tenant will point at your infra. Not a bug, but worth a HANDOFF.md callout.

The BYO fallback logic in llm_provider._byo_target silently switches provider+model if the caller-requested provider's key isn't set (e.g. asks for claude but only OPENAI_API_KEY exists → returns gpt-4o-mini). This is friendly for handoff, but the switch is invisible to the caller. Consider logging a one-line warning the first time a substitution happens, so operators know their model catalogue isn't fully honoured.

generate_speech BYO branch always uses OpenAI TTS; the error string mentions ELEVENLABS_API_KEY but the code has no ElevenLabs path in that function. In practice studio.py's TTS goes through the emergent branch, and the ElevenLabs branch is elsewhere in extras.py (gen_voice) — but the misleading error message should be tightened to just 'Text-to-speech needs OPENAI_API_KEY or EMERGENT_LLM_KEY.'

storage.py STORAGE_DRIVER default 'proxy' is honoured: all uploads still return /api/public/files/* URLs and behaviour is identical to before (verified end-to-end via /apps/{id}/files upload+list+download and /media/upload).

PUT /api/apps/{id}/theme silently drops site_skin — carry-over CRITICAL from iter64. Confirmed unchanged this iteration; still needs the one-line fix in studio.py (add 'site_skin':'classic' to DEFAULT_THEME). This is NOT introduced by iter65 and is out of scope for the handoff-readiness pass, but flagging so it isn't lost during handoff.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (dashboard + templates + tenant Overview all render with 0 console/page errors)

test_credentials: jaybernabe@luciodigital.com / Lucio2026! — worked. client.editor@example.com / ClientEdit2026! — worked (403 on PATCH /ai/models as expected).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression net /app/backend/tests/test_iter65_llm_refactor.py takes ~35s and covers the full LLM-refactor surface plus /files, /media, /domain, /ai/models. Safe to run on every subsequent iteration to catch any llm_provider drift. Frontend smoke uses email/password form via page.get_by_role('button', name='Sign in').first — do NOT click page.locator('button[type=submit]').first because that resolves to 'Continue with Google' and pops open the Google OAuth screen. Iter64's outstanding site_skin/_clean_theme bug is still present but is not a P0 handoff blocker.
rca of the issue: N/A — no regression introduced by the llm_provider.py refactor. All AI-powered endpoints (ai/edit, ai/seo, ai/lead-summary, media/image) round-trip cleanly through the new get_chat / generate_image seams. /media/config booleans are correctly sourced from llm_provider.image_available()/video_available(). Custom-domain DNS check honours the new env-driven DNS_CNAME_TARGET. Proxy storage driver behaviour is byte-identical to pre-refactor.
